title: Do not spend this rare life asleep
summary: This meets the life being spent in appetite, distraction, and delay. The line reminds you the human body was obtained with difficulty and can still be wasted.
takeaway: Use this rare life for Naam.
lifeApplication: Before another hour disappears into feeding, scrolling, or showing off, touch the chest and remember the body was not given cheaply. Turn one moment back toward Naam.

source.shortMeaning: A rare human life is squandered when it forgets Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before drift becomes another evening, remember what this life was given for.

evidence.turn: Treat this life as rare enough to center it on Naam.
